description_en: You can call the OpenDcdnService operation to activate DCDN
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn open-dcdn-service --bill-type PayByTraffic --websocket-bill-type websockettraffic --region cn-hangzhou
name: OpenDcdnService

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the service. Valid values:

PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
PayByBandwidth: pay-by-peak-bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
开通服务的计费类型。取值：

PayByTraffic：按流量计费
PayByBandwidth：按带宽峰值
parameters.name: bill_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the WebSocket service. Valid values:

websockettraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
websocketbps: pay-by-peak-bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
开通服务的Websocket计费类型。取值：

websockettraffic：按流量计费
websocketbps：按带宽峰值
parameters.name: websocket_bill_type
